checks: Edit mode is explicit and disabled by default; service requires exact verified explicit program_paths and never falls back to support paths.
Existing broker session lifetime, UID/ancestry/socket peer, request replay and cumulative byte guards precede new dispatch.
Prepare is bound to canonical complete authenticated envelope and existing baseline/view/source/generation/policy pins; owner prepares mapping only.
Worker independently verifies the complete original and candidate bytes under existing worker write rights; no fake IsolatedWorktree, owner mutation grant or lease.
Confirmation requires the entire admitted postimage, refreshes generation and clears candidate context. Failed stale generations discard cached views and cannot be reused.
No unsupported semantic/proof/current-index authority follows from a successful edit; returned status remains validation pending.
Post-write transport or confirmation failures retain written_confirmation_unknown and never automatically retry the edit.
Edit-ready source rendering is explicit; ordinary working reads preserve legacy default projection and loader behavior.
Closed source-session@4 accounting distinguishes delivered mapping/confirmation pages; zero source bytes assigned to edit pages; discovery field pair mandatory for editing.
Router and descriptor selected mode/policy are joined before actual dispatch; guidance uses selected edit mode and is charged in prompt bytes.
limitations: One authored Python comment-removal fixture qualified in Docker; host suites cover additional mapping refusal/UTF8/CRLF/staleness cases.
No live provider token savings, benchmark task success or full supervisor START result.
Worker-local full source reads are privately required for preimage checking; only model-visible original expansion is avoided.
Successful candidate edit and smoke do not refresh/discharge symbolic proofs or authorize publication.
Source population covers owner-admitted paths; unrelated/unadmitted files are outside confirmation scope.
private_evidence_exclusions: raw prompts, router transcripts, live source session descriptors, owner private databases

resolved_findings.impact: ValueError API contract changed to AttributeError; ordinary transport callers validate local dicts so no authentication or write bypass was identified.
resolved_findings.issue: Edit dispatch read request.get before validating a malformed non-dict local request.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact dict type guard before dispatch; five malformed request regression cases.

reviewer_scope: Independent read-only review of broker/client dispatch, cache generation, descriptor/router/collector joins. Core service authored by this reviewer and independently reviewed by another agent.
